questions.q: Why can you report on lead conversion at all after leads have been converted?
options: Converted leads are copied to a separate archive object
Converted leads stay in the database with the Converted checkbox set, alongside the account, contact and opportunity they created
Conversion only changes the lead's owner
Salesforce recreates them each night from the account
questions.explain: Conversion creates new records but leaves the lead itself in place, flagged as converted, so it remains reportable.

questions.q: Which report setup gives you converted and unconverted counts by lead source side by side?
options: A tabular report sorted by Created Date
A summary report grouped by Owner only
A joined report of Leads and Accounts
A matrix of Leads with Lead Source in rows and Converted in columns
questions.explain: A matrix with Lead Source rows and the Converted checkbox as columns, using Record Count, shows both counts and lets you divide converted by total.

questions.q: What does averaging a row-level formula that returns 1 for converted leads and 0 otherwise give you?
options: The conversion rate
The average days to convert
The total number of leads
The average deal amount
questions.explain: The mean of ones and zeros is the share of leads that converted, which is the conversion rate.

questions.q: A report of leads created this month shows a very low conversion rate. What is the most likely explanation?
options: Marketing has stopped generating quality leads
The Converted field is not reportable
Most of those leads are too new to have converted yet (the cohort trap)
Conversion rate cannot be calculated in a matrix
questions.explain: Young leads have had little time to convert. Use a closed period or group by created month and interpret recent months as still maturing.

questions.q: Why should you check your org's Lead Status picklist before publishing a conversion report?
options: Lead Status cannot be used in filters
Status values are customized per org, so assumed values like 'Qualified' may not exist
Lead Status is always identical across orgs
Lead Status controls who can view the report
questions.explain: Picklist values are customized, so filtering on an assumed status can silently exclude the wrong leads.
